newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 30.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the benchmark Kuala Lumpur Composite Index rose 9.29 points or 0.85 percent to 1,105.62.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5096/01 a dollar at around 0900 GMT on Thursday against 2.5095/05 at Wednesday's close.
* National carrier Malaysia Airline reported full year net earnings of 332.86 million ringgit, above expectations. Profits helped by 43.8 million ringgit gain from selling two aircraft.
* "It (the MAS earnings) seem to be a bit over our expectations, even if you exclude the plane sales," said Lai Tak Heong, research director at Socgen-Crosby.
He said analysts would learn more about the results following a briefing on Friday with MAS management.

* The Composite Index's close above 1,100 pierced a psychologically important level, but analysts say buying has been sporadic and focused on a handful of stocks such as Telekom ahead of the deadline to capture a bonus issue.
* Packaging maker HPI Resources Bhd is scheduled to list on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board, at an offer price of 3.10 ringgit a share.
